pr_chr_ned.bible: {{PR_NED}} is an English man from {{PR_DOVER}}. Face visible. He speaks the law. He is not a party, not a soldier, not a mask.
pr_chr_ned.desc: Photoreal English man early 40s, {{PR_DOVER}} weather on the skin, short brown hair going grey at the temples, clean-shaven, grey-green eyes, work jacket over a plain shirt, no tie, no uniform, no balaclava, no costume, face fully visible, South East England, not a model, not a soldier, not a politician, still, Channel daylight on him

pr_loc_port.bible: The {{PR_PORT}} on the {{PR_CHANNEL}}. A working lung: ferries, freight, wet tarmac. Not a battlefield.
pr_loc_port.desc: Photoreal Eastern Docks of the {{PR_PORT}}, dawn, cold Channel light, wet tarmac, white roll-on roll-off ferry with orange lifeboats at the berth, lorries, fenders, gulls, white cliffs distant in clear air, industrial harbour not a holiday postcard, NOT a helicopter, NOT a cruise liner, NOT Miami

pr_loc_workshop.bible: A shed that still makes things. Trade is a bench and a tool, not a speech.
pr_loc_workshop.desc: Photoreal small English workshop shed, brick and corrugated roof, bench, welder's mask on a hook unused, steel, grease, a kettle, {{PR_CHANNEL}} light through a dirty window, {{PR_ULTIMATE_LAW}} mark as a small printed card on the wall not a heraldic blob, NOT a Hollywood forge, NOT a factory CGI bay

pr_loc_terrace.bible: A {{PR_DOVER}} terrace. The cost lands on a doormat.
pr_loc_terrace.desc: Photoreal {{PR_DOVER}} brick terrace street, parked vans, net curtains, a council envelope on a worn doormat, overcast Channel light, wet pavement, no crowd, no protest, no flags

pr_loc_door.bible: {{PR_COKE}}: a man's house is his castle. A latch. Not a crowd's street.
pr_loc_door.desc: Photoreal English front door, paint worn, brass latch and letterbox, close enough to see the metal, interior dark behind, daylight on the step, no castle, no manor, no flag

pr_loc_table.bible: A table. A paper. A phone. Judgments are named, not headlined.
pr_loc_table.desc: Photoreal cafe table in {{PR_DOVER}}, Formica, a folded English newspaper with a panic headline out of focus, a mobile phone face-up showing a short police statement, mug of tea, window with harbour light, no TV debate, no studio
